params.name: messageId
params.description: The ID of the message to which the alert should be associated.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the alert.

params.name: riskId
params.description: The numeric risk representation ('0 - Informational' through '3 - High').

params.name: confidenceId
params.description: The numeric confidence representation ('1 - Low' through '3 - High' [user set values '0 - False Positive', and '4 - User Confirmed' are also available]).

params.name: description
params.description: The description to be set to the alert.

params.name: param
params.description: The name of the parameter applicable to the alert.

params.name: attack
params.description: The attack (ex: injected string) used by the scan rule.

params.name: otherInfo
params.description: Other information about the alert or test.

params.name: solution
params.description: The solution for the alert.

params.name: references
params.description: The reference details for the alert.

params.name: evidence
params.description: The evidence associated with the alert.

params.name: cweId
params.description: The CWE identifier associated with the alert.

params.name: wascId
params.description: The WASC identifier associated with the alert.
